title: Diagonal completion of the normalized unit cocycle
statement: Under the hypotheses of the off-diagonal unit cocycle normalization, if d and a_i satisfy the normalization equation for every i != j, then the same equation holds for every diagonal pair i=i.

proof.text: Use the cocycle equation with repeated indices to obtain the diagonal unit relation. Apply the same repeated-index argument to the standard transition cocycle, substitute the equations for a pair and its reverse, and cancel the chart unit. This gives the normalization equation on each diagonal overlap.
